verify that your laptop is fully updated and encrypted
check that BitLocker (Windows) or FileVault (macOS) is active and that the recovery key is backed up in Intune
ensure the latest Windows security patches (released on Patch Tuesday) are installed, or that macOS is up to date via Software Update
confirm that your GlobalProtect machine certificate is valid (certificates renew yearly) and that you have a copy of the certificate or know how to re-enroll if needed
pack the laptop in a padded sleeve, keep the charger and any adapters in a separate compartment, and label the bag with your name and employee ID
open the Company Portal app and verify that the device shows "Compliant"
for Windows: run `manage-bde -status` in an elevated PowerShell prompt to confirm BitLocker protection and note the recovery key ID
for macOS: open System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> FileVault and ensure it is turned on; note the recovery key stored in Intune
connect to VPN (vpn.acme.example) and confirm the connection succeeds; if prompted, renew the certificate via the Self-Service Portal
